docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
An English translation of the Upaniṣads with the commentary of Śaṅkarācārya, in the Madras edition of the end of the nineteenth century (volume 4).

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised by the Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts / Archaeological Survey of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Upanishads and Sri Sankaraʼs commentary vol.4 · Sastri, Sitaram · 1899, 398 scanned pages. Published 1899; the translator S. Sitarama Sastri died before 1930; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
